info.name: Citrix ADC (NetScaler) NITRO Access Policies Sessions API
info.description:
REST API for configuring and monitoring Citrix ADC (NetScaler) application delivery controllers, including load balancing virtual servers, services, service groups, SSL certificates, content switching, and system statistics.
